why: NODE_ENV=production set before npm ci skips devDependencies, so the TypeScript build in the same stage fails or ships untranspiled. Set it after the build, in the runtime stage.
bad:
ENV NODE_ENV=production
RUN npm ci
RUN npm run build
good:
RUN npm ci
RUN npm run build
FROM node:24.11.0-slim
ENV NODE_ENV=production
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
